focus: Pyramidal: mostly Z1-Z2 with one tempo session per sport; build swim consistency and heavy strength.
reasons: Peak week set to 11.0 h (range 11-14 h) from your recent 5.2 h/wk and CTL 40.
Goal 5.00 h needs ~7:47/mi off the bike; that is 104% of your current threshold speed (8:04/mi) - threshold needs to come down before this is realistic.
Base phase (cap 7.7 h/wk). Last week you did 4.9 h, so this week ramps to at most +10%.
Only 50% of last week's sessions were completed, so volume is held rather than increased.

workouts.title: Swim: technique + short intervals
workouts.description: WU 200 easy + 4x50 drill/swim. Main: 8-12x50 focus on catch & body position, 15s rest. Then 4x100 steady, 20s rest. CD 100. ~35 min total.

workouts.title: Strength: heavy + plyo
workouts.description: Core (planks, dead bugs, bird dogs) 10 min. Squats or trap-bar deadlift 4x4-6 heavy (>80% 1RM, 3 min rest), RDLs 3x6, single-leg calf raises 3x10. Then 3x8 pogo hops + 3x5 drop jumps. Hip mobility 10 min.

workouts.title: Tempo run
workouts.description: WU 15 min easy. 2x10 min at Z3 with 3 min jog between. CD 10 min. Add 4x20s strides.

workouts.title: Cadence + tempo
workouts.description: WU 15 min. 3x10 min at low Z3, 90-95 rpm, 5 min easy between. CD 10 min.

workouts.title: Swim: endurance
workouts.description: WU 300 easy. Main: 4x200 steady, 30s rest. Practice sighting every 6-8 strokes on one set. CD 200. ~40 min.

workouts.title: Rest day
workouts.description: Full rest or 20 min gentle walk / mobility.

workouts.title: Long ride
workouts.description: Steady aerobic ride, mostly Z2 (135-149 bpm). Fuel 90 g carbs/h (2:1 glucose:fructose); on long rides in build/peak practise up to 120 g/h to train the gut. Drink to thirst.

workouts.title: Long run
workouts.description: Easy, conversational. Walk breaks are fine early in the plan. Fuel every 30-40 min.
